description: Copies the questions from a public Google Form, Typeform, or Tally form into a new Clipform. The source form and its responses stay where they are. Supported URLs: Google Forms (docs.google.com or forms.gle - must be shared as "Anyone with the link"), Typeform (form.typeform.com/to/...), and Tally (tally.so - must be public). The source form must be publicly accessible; a private form's questions cannot be read. The new Clipform goes live straight away unless you pass is_live: false (then it stays a draft with a preview link, and clipform_update_form with is_live: true publishes it later). An anonymous guest's import is checked first and stays a draft with a preview link if that check refuses it. Some question types don't map cleanly to a Clipform node and are skipped rather than guessed at; the result always reports exactly what was imported vs skipped, and why.

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

is_live.description: Publish the imported form right away. Default true. Pass false to keep it a draft (use preview_url to review it).

url.description: Public URL of the Google Form, Typeform, or Tally form to import

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in (id from clipform_whoami workspaces). Omit to use the connection's default workspace.

name: clipform_import_form

builder_url.description: Link to edit the form in the Clipform builder. Null for an anonymous session or when nothing was created.

form_id.description: New form's UUID - pass to follow-up tools. Null when no importable questions were found (nothing was created).

imported.description: Questions successfully converted into Clipform nodes

skipped.description: Questions that could not be converted

skipped_details.description: Per-skipped-question title, reason, and source question type

total_questions.description: Total questions found in the source form

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues surfaced during the import

is_live.description: True when the imported form is live at viewer_url. False for a draft, and also false when nothing was created. Null only when the API did not say (treat as a draft).

live_refused_reason.description: Why an anonymous guest's import was kept as a draft instead of going live. Null otherwise.

preview_url.description: A time-limited link to view the unpublished draft right now - open this one to review a draft. Null when the form is live or nothing was created.

viewer_url.description: The form's public address. It is live now when is_live is true; otherwise it is where the form WILL be live once published (clipform_update_form with is_live: true), and opening it now shows a maintenance screen. Null when no importable questions were found.

workspace_name.description: Name of the workspace the form was created in

title: Import Form
